# Commit as kimoxstudio-dev

This project deploys to Vercel under a team on the **Hobby plan**. Hobby
deploys only commits whose **author** is the project's owner, and fails every
other one with:

```
the commit author did not have contributing access to the project
```

What Vercel reads is the author's **email**, not who pushed. So every commit
here carries the studio's identity, whoever is at the keyboard:

```
user.name   kimoxstudio-dev
user.email  kimoxstudio@gmail.com
```

## Before the first commit in any checkout

The identity is set **per repository**, never globally — it must not leak into
other work on the same machine. Git does not copy it on clone, and a worktree
made by `kx-session` shares the original's `.git/config` only when that config
was set there first. So check, and set it if it is not there:

```bash
git config user.email
```

Anything other than `kimoxstudio@gmail.com`, or nothing at all:

```bash
git config user.email "kimoxstudio@gmail.com"
git config user.name  "kimoxstudio-dev"
```

**Test:** `git config user.email` inside the repository prints the studio's
address. If it does not, do not commit yet.

## Say who really wrote it

The author field is spoken for, so the person goes in the message. End the
subject with the real committer's name in parentheses:

```
fix(header): keep the logo inside the safe area on iPhone (Adrián)
```

Everything else about the message follows `kx-commit`.

## A commit already landed with the wrong author

Fix it before waiting on the deploy — the build has already failed and will
not retry on its own. With the identity set as above:

```bash
git commit --amend --reset-author --no-edit     # the last commit
git push --force-with-lease
```

For anything older than the last commit, re-author the range with
`git rebase -i` and `--reset-author` on each, then force-push with lease.
Never a plain `--force`: it is a shared branch, and the lease is what stops
it overwriting somebody else's push.

## What not to do

- Do not change the identity to your own to "sign" a commit. The deploy
  breaks, and the fix is the amend above.
- Do not add a `Co-Authored-By` trailer as a substitute for the name in the
  subject. `kx-commit` forbids the trailer, and Vercel does not read it.
- Do not set the identity with `--global`. Other repositories on this machine
  belong to other people and other accounts.
